tips.0: Warm up for 5–10 minutes before lifting to reduce injury risk.
tips.1: Focus on form over weight — quality reps build more muscle safely.
tips.2: Rest 48 hours between training the same muscle group.
tips.3: Stay hydrated: drink water before, during, and after your workout.
tips.4: Progressive overload — gradually increase weight or reps each week.
tips.5: Sleep is when your muscles grow. Aim for 7–9 hours per night.
tips.6: Compound movements like squats and deadlifts give the best ROI.
